decisions.quote:
In our attempt to replicate Tschudin (2001, 2006), two adult male bottlenose dolphins (Tursiops
truncatus) and their trainers (5 and 20 years of experience, respectively) were selected.
decisions.location: A Case Study - Attempted Replication, lines 570-571
decisions.reason: The authors collected new experimental data with bottlenose dolphins at SeaWorld San Antonio to re-test the nonverbal false belief task findings of Tschudin (2001, 2006), making this a replication.
